---
name: Community role interest
about: Volunteer to review Embers Kernel, or express interest in future maintainership.
title: "Community role interest: "
---

Thanks for offering to help Embers Kernel. This is a **public** issue. Do not include private personal data, credentials, exploit details, or proprietary material. See [the role guide](../../docs/CONTRIBUTOR_ROLES.md) before posting.

### Area of interest

Which role are you interested in?

- [ ] Community reviewer (no special repository permissions)
- [ ] Future maintainer consideration (not an appointment or access request)

Which area(s) would you like to help review? For example, Rust `no_std`, x86-64/QEMU, paging, unsafe/assembly, capabilities, IPC, concurrency, or testing.

### Evidence or starting point

Link one or more public GitHub issues, reviews, PRs, technical notes, or reproducible experiments you have contributed to. If you are new, link the issue/PR you would like to start reviewing instead.

### What can you contribute?

Describe a review question you can investigate, the testing environment you have available if relevant, and any limitations you already know about. An approximate, nonbinding level of availability is optional.

### Expectations

- [ ] I have read [the Code of Conduct](../../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and [community role guide](../../docs/CONTRIBUTOR_ROLES.md).
- [ ] I understand that interest or recognition does not grant repository write/admin access, automatic GitHub approval rights, or a guaranteed role.

If you need to report a vulnerability, use the private path described in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) rather than this issue.
